items.title_kr: Macy's, California Northridge Fashion Center에 Toys R Us store 가을 open 예정
items.title_en: Toys R Us Opening This Fall At Northridge Fashion Center
items.body_kr: Macy's가 향후 캘리포니아 Northridge Fashion Center에 Toys R Us store를 새롭게 open하며 유통 채널 다각화에 나섭니다. 장난감 category의 traffic 유입 효과가 벤더사들의 마케팅 및 Holiday merchandise 기획에 긍정적인 영향을 미칠 전망입니다.
items.body_en: Macy's continues its toy retailer comeback by opening a new Toys R Us store at Northridge Fashion Center this fall. This traffic-driving partnership offers favorable retail signals for vendor merchandising strategies.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, Walmart 출신 패션 임원을 새로운 chief merchant로 영입
items.title_en: Kohl’s Names Walmart Fashion Alum as Chief Merchant
items.body_kr: Kohl's has appointed a former Walmart fashion executive as its new chief merchant, effective September 28. This leadership change will shape future merchandise strategies and category assortments.

items.title_kr: Kohl's, DoorDash partnership 통해 back-to-school 배송 채널 확대
items.title_en: Forgot something for school? DoorDash adds Gap, Barnes & Noble, Carter’s and Kohl’s
items.body_kr: Kohl's has expanded its delivery capabilities via DoorDash to cover back-to-school apparel and dorm gear. This retail channel integration aims to capture urgent consumer demand during peak season.

items.title_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch, 탄탄한 의류 수요 힘입어 full-year forecast 상향 조정
items.title_en: Abercrombie raises full-year forecasts on robust apparel demand, shares jump
items.body_kr: Abercrombie & Fitch raised its full-year forecasts following a strong Q2 earnings beat driven by robust apparel demand. This positive outlook signals healthy sell-through rates across core categories.

items.title_kr: Macy's, Holiday season 대비 exclusive Disney Capsule Collection 확장 공개
items.title_en: The Disney x Macy’s Holiday Capsule Expands With Whimsical Takes on Diamond Necklaces, Sweatshirts, Crossbodies, and More
items.body_kr: Macy's has expanded its exclusive Disney x Macy's Holiday capsule collection with whimsical designs across multiple categories. This IP-driven assortment is designed to boost holiday retail traffic and sales.
